answer: Special Ops decoy rule: salt the grading queue. Each epoch the network slips hidden pearl answers into seats, written by the protocol with a known true score, some sharp, some hollow copies dressed in a farm's own style. A grader's attestation weight is its running accuracy on pearls it can't tell from real work. A sybil farm that rubber-stamps its siblings also stamps the planted fakes, so its votes sink to zero weight and its self-made oasis dries up. Every voyage through the queue now demands honest care, or it pays nothing.
